data.name: Alviani
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Alviani is derived from the name Alvis, which means 'elf' or 'wanderer'. The suffix -ian denotes a friend or companion. Thus, Alviani can be translated as 'friend of Elvis'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the elven sage Alvian, who provided spiritual guidance to St. Columba.
